ciAtTestedHead: Read on GitHub, not re-run: at a26b7e98 the required lint, typecheck, test and pr-title succeeded (one more pr-title run queued), and so did changes, the envoy lanes and the Release Envoy Listener jobs. Worker Image's `build` (run 40666033938, not required) failed: curl (92) 'HTTP/2 stream 1 was not closed cleanly: INTERNAL_ERROR' while downloading uv from github.com in packages/daemon/docker/worker.Dockerfile, which this PR does not touch. It is a transient network failure, not a defect of this change.
notes: The 'Not proven / risk' lines the reviewer wrote at round 2 still say that each main run writes mode=min blobs and that the hit was measured only on a re-run. At a26b7e98 no cache is written at all, so the reviewer's round-3 rewrite should drop them.
A2 (7-day main median < 8 min) runs only after the merge; the production check owns it. Uncached branch runs give a slower leg of 4.32-5.33 min.
